claim: Loading a later page of the media library keeps the thumbnail or waveform already generated for previously loaded items instead of dropping every earlier preview and falling back to the neutral placeholder.

verification.detail: The job ran dart format, flutter analyze and the full flutter test suite on the canonical Flutter 3.47.5 pin. apps/or_app/test/widget_test.dart contains the regression that mounts 55 media items with cached previews, loads the second 50-item page and scrolls back to the top, requiring the first item's thumbnail to survive; the same assertion found no media-preview-image-media-0 before the fix. The repository hygiene job of the same run set passed the preflight-preparation checks added alongside it. Linux UI preflight run 39017187058 passed separately at the same SHA with the analyzer, the focused component/semantics tests and the real Linux create/import/edit/undo/seek/save-reopen journey under a bounded Xvfb display.

limitations: Hosted widget evidence is component/semantics evidence: it proves the preview state survives a later page load in the Flutter widget tree, not GPU rendering or native artifact decoding.
The Linux UI preflight journey substitutes the file picker and runs a debug app; it is not packaged acceptance or an OS-picker check.
Android SAF behaviour, macOS and Windows packaged journeys, and physical-device responsiveness are separate gates and are not established by this record.
Only disposable Flutter presentation state changed: no command was dispatched and canonical project state and ProjectRevision are unchanged.
The broader offline-media and bulk-relink workflow named by the roadmap remains unimplemented and unverified.
